text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Thanks for today too. Well, I'll 
be heading out first, then.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I've got something important to take 
care of now.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I'm back. Sorry I'm late!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
N-No... I-I also... just got back myself, 
so...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Glad to hear that. Well then, 
shall we get started?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: —This month's "Chat Session"!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Ah! The filling is smooth red bean 
paste...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
You preferred smooth red bean paste, 
right, Cheval-san? Koshian—I remember!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Th-Thank you very much. This... is 
delicious. So very delicious...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: "...Um, Shion-san. Er..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I... also bought a steamed meat 
bun...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Thanks for going out of your way! 
Even though it was my turn to do the 
grocery run this month.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Because it was delicious. I wanted to 
eat it... together with you.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
And... this is a thank-you gift. You're 
always... so kind to me...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Gentle? No way! Cheval-san is way 
more gentle than me...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
T-That's not true! Shion-san, you're 
definitely...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Just recently too... when I ended up 
coming home late... she went to sleep 
without waiting up for me...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure... you did that so I wouldn't 
have to worry... right...?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha. Guess you saw right through me, 
huh?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
It's things like that... that really help 
me out... so much...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Besides, even this "Story Time" is...—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Because I'm not good at talking... 
Shion-san started the conversation for my 
sake...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
—I'm really looking forward to it... The 
day of... the 'Meet & Greet'...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Th-Thank you very much...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Cheval-san...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, same here. Hearing you say 
that... yeah.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I'm super happy that we have the kind of 
relationship where you can tell me that!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant*... How was it? My time...
choice_data_list: You're looking much better than yesterday!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Just like this... keep up the 
momentum!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Win Variation seems even more motivated 
than usual. Apparently, she had a modest 
little party with a friend in her room 
yesterday—
choice_data_list:
That was such a graceful run. Maybe taking 
a breather helped.

Now that's a powerful run with plenty to 
spare!

Now that's a powerful run with composure 
to spare!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Win Variation seems even more motivated 
than usual. Apparently, she had a modest 
little party with a friend in her room 
yesterday—
choice_data_list:
That was such a graceful run. Maybe taking 
a breather helped.

Now that's a powerful run with plenty to 
spare!

Now that's a powerful run with composure 
to spare!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Yep! 100% thanks to that! I can swear on 
it!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...I thought it didn't matter if it went 
unnoticed. Just a little act of 
consideration—for my roommate.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
And yet... heheh. I was just so happy you 
understood it all.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I could keep going forever 
today, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. You really think so? Thank you very 
much.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...You might've already figured it out, 
Trainer, but..."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"For better or worse, I'm the type whose 
running is directly tied to my mental 
state—"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm in great shape right now. 
Heheh.
